note: 主题翻译：给一句中文，写英文，再对照。hint 用 / 分隔 2-3 个关键词，why 只讲搭配和介词。前 6 组是自拟句，后面是按范文批次抽的句子（src 标出处）。

sentences.zh: 塑料污染是一个越来越严重的问题。
sentences.en: Plastic pollution is a growing problem.
sentences.why: a growing problem 比 more and more serious 简洁，形容问题恶化时这是最常见的形式。

sentences.zh: 一次性袋子只用几分钟，却要几百年才能分解。
sentences.hint: 一次性 / 分解 / break down
sentences.en: A single-use bag is used for a few minutes but takes centuries to break down.
sentences.why: break down 是「分解」的常用说法；take + 时间 + to do 表示「需要多久才能做完」。

sentences.zh: 大部分塑料袋来自石油，而石油是有限的资源。
sentences.en: Most plastic bags are made from oil, which is a limited resource.
sentences.why: be made from 用于看不出原形的原料（塑料来自石油）；be made of 用于还能看出材质的东西。

sentences.zh: 这些袋子最后流进了海洋。
sentences.hint: 最后流进 / end up in
sentences.en: These bags end up in the ocean.
sentences.why: end up in 表示「最终落到某个（往往不好的）地方」，比 finally go to 自然得多。

sentences.zh: 海洋动物会误食塑料碎片。
sentences.en: Marine animals eat plastic pieces by mistake.
sentences.why: by mistake 放句末；也可以说 mistake plastic for food，介词用 for。

sentences.zh: 每个人都能少用一点。
sentences.hint: 少用一点 / a little less
sentences.en: Everyone can use a little less.
sentences.why: less 修饰不可数名词；a little less 比 use fewer 更适合泛指「用量少一点」。

sentences.zh: 政府应该让回收变得更容易。
sentences.en: The government should make recycling easier.
sentences.why: make + 宾语 + 形容词，easier 是形容词比较级，不能写成 more easy。

sentences.zh: 收费比直接禁止更容易执行。
sentences.en: A charge is easier to enforce than a ban.
sentences.why: enforce a rule / a ban 是固定搭配；easier to do 后面接动词原形。

sentences.zh: 这张图显示了二十年间上网人数的比例。
sentences.en: The chart shows the proportion of people with internet access over a twenty-year period.
sentences.why: the proportion of + 名词；over a period 表示「在一段时间内」，不用 in。

sentences.zh: 1990 年，这个数字不到百分之十。
sentences.en: In 1990, the figure was under ten percent.
sentences.why: 描述数据用 the figure 代替 the number，避免一段里重复 number。

sentences.zh: 之后它稳步上升。
sentences.en: After that, it rose steadily.
sentences.why: steadily 修饰上升的方式，比 quickly 更准确；rise 是不及物动词，后面不接宾语。

sentences.zh: 到 2010 年，它已经翻了一倍。
sentences.en: By 2010, it had doubled.
sentences.why: by + 过去时间表示「到那时为止」，主句用过去完成时 had done。

sentences.zh: 国家 A 一直是最高的。
sentences.en: Country A remained the highest throughout.
sentences.why: remain + 形容词表示保持某种状态；throughout 放句末，表示整段时间都是如此。

sentences.zh: 国家 B 的数字一直紧随其后。
sentences.en: The figure for Country B followed closely behind.
sentences.why: the figure for + 国家；follow closely behind 是固定说法，closely 不能换成 close。

sentences.zh: 两组数字之间的差距逐渐缩小。
sentences.en: The gap between the two groups narrowed gradually.
sentences.why: the gap between A and B；narrow 可以作动词，表示「缩小」。

sentences.zh: 总体来看，增长最明显的是年轻人。
sentences.en: Overall, the clearest growth was among young people.
sentences.why: Task 1 结尾常用 Overall 开头；among + 群体，表示「在……之中」。

sentences.zh: 越来越多的人在家工作。
sentences.hint: 在家工作 / work from home
sentences.en: More and more people work from home.
sentences.why: work from home 的 home 前不加 the；work at home 也可以，但远程办公更常说 from。

sentences.zh: 通勤时间被省下来了。
sentences.en: Commuting time is saved.
sentences.why: commuting 作名词指通勤这件事；这里用被动 is saved，因为重点是时间被省下。

sentences.zh: 员工可以更灵活地安排自己的一天。
sentences.en: Employees can organise their day more flexibly.
sentences.why: 修饰动词 organise 要用副词 flexibly；flexible 只能修饰名词。

sentences.zh: 但在家很容易分心。
sentences.en: But it is easy to get distracted at home.
sentences.why: get + 过去分词表示状态变化；被什么分心用 distracted by。

sentences.zh: 同事之间的交流变少了。
sentences.en: Communication between colleagues becomes less frequent.
sentences.why: between 用于双方之间；less frequent 修饰频率，不能说 less frequently 修饰 becomes。

sentences.zh: 有些工作必须在办公室完成。
sentences.hint: 必须 / have to be done
sentences.en: Some jobs have to be done in the office.
sentences.why: have to be done 是被动结构，表示「必须被完成」，主语是工作不是人。

sentences.zh: 公司可以两种方式都试。
sentences.en: Companies can try both ways.
sentences.why: both 后面接复数名词；try both ways 比 try the two methods 更简洁。

sentences.zh: 关键是工作有没有做完，而不是坐在哪里。
sentences.en: What matters is getting the work done, not where you sit.
sentences.why: What matters is + 动名词，是主语从句结构；get sth done 表示「把某事做完」。

sentences.zh: 很多学生毕业后找不到工作。
sentences.en: Many students cannot find a job after graduation.
sentences.why: after graduation 前不加 the；find a job 用不定冠词，指「一份工作」。

sentences.zh: 学校应该教实用的技能。
sentences.en: Schools should teach practical skills.
sentences.why: practical skills 是常见搭配，比 useful skills 更具体；skill 可数，这里用复数泛指。

sentences.zh: 小组作业能让学生学会合作。
sentences.en: Group work teaches students to cooperate.
sentences.why: teach sb to do；cooperate 后面接 with sb，不能直接加人。

sentences.zh: 父母的影响和老师一样重要。
sentences.hint: 一样重要 / as much as
sentences.en: Parents matter as much as teachers.
sentences.why: as much as 用于比较重要性；matter 作动词表示「重要」，比 are important 更口语自然。

sentences.zh: 大学教育不应该只看分数。
sentences.en: University education should not be judged by grades alone.
sentences.why: be judged by 表示「按……来评判」；alone 放句末表示「仅仅」。

sentences.zh: 有些课程在网上学更方便。
sentences.en: Some courses are easier to take online.
sentences.why: easier to take 后面接动词原形；online 在这里作副词，不加 on。

sentences.zh: 学生需要时间培养自己的兴趣。
sentences.en: Students need time to develop their own interests.
sentences.why: develop an interest 是固定搭配，不用 grow；interest 表示兴趣时可数。

sentences.zh: 好的老师能把难的内容讲简单。
sentences.en: A good teacher can make difficult content simple.
sentences.why: make sth + 形容词，simple 与 difficult 形成对照，不需要 more。

sentences.zh: 广告让人想买自己并不需要的东西。
sentences.en: Advertising makes people want things they do not need.
sentences.why: make sb do 不加 to；things they do not need 是省略了 that 的定语从句。

sentences.zh: 小公司很难和大品牌竞争。
sentences.en: Small companies find it hard to compete with big brands.
sentences.why: compete with 后面接对手；find it hard to do 中 it 是形式宾语，真正的宾语是 to do。

sentences.zh: 价格是顾客最在意的因素。
sentences.en: Price is the factor customers care about most.
sentences.why: care about 表示「在意」；most 放句末修饰 care about。

sentences.zh: 网上购物改变了人们的习惯。
sentences.en: Online shopping has changed people's habits.
sentences.why: 现在完成时强调影响延续到现在，比 changed 更贴合「至今仍在影响」。

sentences.zh: 好的服务能让顾客一再回来。
sentences.en: Good service keeps customers coming back.
sentences.why: keep sb doing 表示让某人持续做某事；coming back 是现在分词。

sentences.zh: 公司应该对自己的产品诚实。
sentences.en: Companies should be honest about their products.
sentences.why: be honest about sth，介词用 about，不用 to 或 with。

sentences.zh: 便宜不一定意味着质量差。
sentences.en: Cheap does not necessarily mean poor quality.
sentences.why: not necessarily 表示「不一定」，比 maybe not 更书面；poor quality 前不加 a。

sentences.zh: 一个品牌的名声要很多年才能建立。
sentences.en: A brand's reputation takes years to build.
sentences.why: reputation 可数，常与 for 连用；take years to do 表示「需要多年才能做到」。

sentences.zh: 政府可以先用收费代替禁止。
sentences.en: The government can use a charge instead of a ban at first.
sentences.why: instead of 后面接名词或动名词，不能接从句；at first 表示「起初」。

sentences.zh: 这项政策对低收入家庭影响最大。
sentences.en: The policy affects low-income families most.
sentences.why: affect 是及物动词，后面直接接宾语，不加 on；effect 才是名词。

sentences.zh: 短期内成本会上升。
sentences.hint: 短期内 / in the short term
sentences.en: Costs will rise in the short term.
sentences.why: in the short term 是固定短语，term 前必须加 the。

sentences.zh: 长期来看，这样更省钱。
sentences.hint: 长期来看 / In the long run
sentences.en: In the long run, it saves money.
sentences.why: in the long run 表示「最终、长远看」，是固定短语，run 前的 the 不能省；也可以说 in the long term。

sentences.zh: 很多人反对这项新规定。
sentences.en: Many people are against the new rule.
sentences.why: be against 后面接名词；oppose 是及物动词，不能写 oppose to。

sentences.zh: 禁令在小商店里很难执行。
sentences.en: A ban is hard to enforce in small shops.
sentences.why: enforce a ban 是固定搭配；hard to do 后面接动词原形。

sentences.zh: 我们需要一个更实际的办法。
sentences.en: We need a more practical solution.
sentences.why: practical solution 是常见搭配；solution 可数，要加 a。

sentences.zh: 如果替代品更便宜，人们就会换。
sentences.en: If alternatives are cheaper, people will switch.
sentences.why: if 引导的条件句用一般现在时，主句用 will；switch 后面可以不加宾语，表示「换掉」。

sentences.zh: 它的目的是让人们相信，买了某个产品会让人更幸福。
sentences.hint: 目的是 / aim to; 说服 / persuade
sentences.en: It aims to persuade people that buying a product will make them happier.
sentences.why: aim to do 用不定式，不说 aim for doing；persuade sb that 后面接完整从句。

sentences.zh: 广告商把重点放在推销一种品牌形象上。
sentences.en: Advertisers focus on selling a brand image.
sentences.why: focus on 后面接动名词；brand image 是固定说法，不说 brand picture。

sentences.zh: 广告是一个雇用了很多人的创意产业。
sentences.en: Advertising is a creative industry that employs many people.
sentences.why: advertising 不可数，作主语用单数动词；industry 可数，泛指要加 a。

sentences.zh: 公司需要让顾客了解自己的产品。
sentences.hint: 让某人了解 / tell sb about
sentences.en: Companies need to tell customers about their products.
sentences.why: tell sb about sth 中间不加 to；products 可数，泛指用复数。

sentences.zh: 我们现在生活在一个消费文化里。
sentences.en: We now live in a consumer culture.
sentences.why: consumer 作定语修饰名词时用单数，如 consumer culture、consumer goods。

sentences.zh: 如果没有广告，失业率会更高。
sentences.en: Without advertising there would be higher unemployment.
sentences.why: without 短语代替 if 从句时，主句用 would；unemployment 不可数，不加 a。

sentences.zh: 他们用有魅力、成功的人来卖产品。
sentences.en: They use glamorous, successful people to sell products.
sentences.why: glamorous 指光鲜、有吸引力，比 beautiful 更贴广告语境；people 是复数，不加 s。

sentences.zh: 我们被说服去追随最新的潮流。
sentences.en: We are persuaded to follow the latest trend.
sentences.why: follow the latest trend 是固定搭配；trend 可数，要加 the。

sentences.zh: 中学毕业后，青少年面临一个两难：去找工作，还是继续读书。
sentences.hint: 面临两难 / face the dilemma
sentences.en: When they finish school, teenagers face the dilemma of whether to get a job or continue their education.
sentences.why: the dilemma of whether to do A or do B；dilemma 可数，要加 the。

sentences.zh: 很多职业都要求学历。
sentences.en: Academic qualifications are required in many professions.
sentences.why: qualification 表示学历、资格时常用复数；被动 are required 比 need 书面。

sentences.zh: 没有相应的学位，就不可能成为医生、老师或律师。
sentences.hint: 相应的学位 / the relevant degree
sentences.en: It is impossible to become a doctor, teacher or lawyer without having the relevant degree.
sentences.why: without 后面接动名词 having；the relevant degree 的 the 表示对应的那一个。

sentences.zh: 结果是，大学毕业生能得到更多、更好的工作机会。
sentences.hint: 有机会得到 / have access to
sentences.en: As a result, university graduates have access to more and better job opportunities.
sentences.why: have access to 的 to 是介词，后面接名词；graduates 复数指群体。

sentences.zh: 就业市场正变得越来越激烈。
sentences.en: The job market is becoming increasingly competitive.
sentences.why: increasingly 修饰形容词，比 more and more 书面；competitive 前不加 very。

sentences.zh: 通过强制人们选择特定专业，政府可以确保经济中的知识和技能缺口都被填补。
sentences.en: By forcing people to choose particular subjects, governments can ensure that any knowledge and skill gaps in the economy are covered.
sentences.why: by + 动名词放句首表示手段；ensure that 后面要接完整从句。

sentences.zh: 如果学生对自己所学的东西有热情，社会会获益更多。
sentences.hint: 对…有热情 / be passionate about
sentences.en: Society will benefit more if our students are passionate about what they are learning.
sentences.why: passionate about 后面接名词或 what 从句；benefit 在这里是不及物动词。

sentences.zh: 没有人能真正预测，哪些领域的知识将来对社会最有用。
sentences.en: Nobody can really predict which areas of knowledge will be most useful to society in the future.
sentences.why: predict 后面直接接宾语从句，不说 predict about；useful to society 用 to。

sentences.zh: 科技以多种方式影响了人与人之间的关系。
sentences.en: Technology has affected relationships in various ways.
sentences.why: affect 是及物动词，直接接宾语，不能写 affect on。

sentences.zh: 电话和互联网让不同国家的商务人士不用见面就能交流。
sentences.hint: 让某人做某事 / allow sb to do
sentences.en: Telephones and the Internet allow business people in different countries to interact without ever meeting each other.
sentences.why: allow sb to do sth，中间的宾语不能省；without ever doing 表示从来没有。

sentences.zh: 如今，用邮件、电话或视频进行的交流，几乎和当面见面一样好。
sentences.hint: 和…一样好 / as good as
sentences.en: Nowadays, interactions by email, phone or video are almost as good as face-to-face meetings.
sentences.why: as ... as 中间用形容词原级；by email 用 by，不用 with。

sentences.zh: 新的通讯技术普及之后，也可能造成让人变得孤立的结果。
sentences.hint: 导致 / have the result of
sentences.en: The availability of new communication technologies can also have the result of isolating people.
sentences.why: have the result of 后面接动名词；availability 不可数，不加 a。

sentences.zh: 很多年轻人宁愿在网上交朋友，也不愿和现实中的同龄人来往。
sentences.en: Many young people choose to make friends online rather than mixing with their peers in the real world.
sentences.why: rather than 前后结构要平行；peer 指同龄人，泛指用复数。

sentences.zh: 这些虚拟关系没法替代真正的友谊。
sentences.en: These virtual relationships are a poor substitute for real friendships.
sentences.why: a substitute for sth，介词是 for；poor 在这里是差劲的，不是穷。

sentences.zh: 玩游戏很容易让人上瘾，因为用户不断得到分数、新目标和频繁的奖励。
sentences.en: Gaming can be highly addictive because users are constantly given scores, new targets and frequent rewards.
sentences.why: addictive 形容事物让人上瘾，人上瘾要用 be addicted to。

sentences.zh: 这种上瘾的影响，从睡眠不足一直到学业出问题。
sentences.en: This type of addiction can have effects ranging from lack of sleep to problems at school.
sentences.why: range from A to B；effects 是复数，配 ranging。

sentences.zh: 有些艺术项目确实需要国家的支持。
sentences.en: Some art projects definitely require help from the state.
sentences.why: require 直接接宾语，比 need 书面；the state 指政府。

sentences.zh: 我认为艺术项目的钱应该同时来自政府和其他渠道。
sentences.en: I believe that money for art projects should come from both governments and other sources.
sentences.why: come from 后面接来源；both A and B 两边要对称。

sentences.zh: 有人认为，把钱花在保护野生动物上没有意义。
sentences.en: Some people argue that it is pointless to spend money on the protection of wild animals.
sentences.why: it is pointless to do sth，it 是形式主语；spend money on 用 on。

sentences.zh: 说野生动物在 21 世纪没有位置，这是荒谬的。
sentences.en: It is absurd to argue that wild animals have no place in the 21st century.
sentences.why: have no place in 是固定说法；absurd 比 wrong 语气重，用来驳对方观点。

sentences.zh: 通常是自然栖息地的保护，才保证了野生动物的生存。
sentences.en: It is usually the protection of natural habitats that ensures the survival of wild animals.
sentences.why: 这是 It is ... that 强调句，去掉 It is 和 that，句子仍然完整。

sentences.zh: 如果我们毁掉这些地区，代价会远远超过保护的成本。
sentences.en: If we destroyed these areas, the costs would far outweigh the costs of conservation.
sentences.why: 虚拟条件用过去式 destroyed，主句用 would；far 修饰 outweigh，不用 very。

sentences.zh: 在伦敦，对司机征收拥堵费帮助缓解了交通问题。
sentences.en: In London, the introduction of a congestion charge for drivers has helped to curb the traffic problem.
sentences.why: a charge for sb/sth；curb 是抑制，比 stop 温和也更准确。

sentences.zh: 政府当然可以更努力地去减少空气污染。
sentences.en: Governments could certainly make more effort to reduce air pollution.
sentences.why: make an effort to do sth，effort 可数；reduce 直接接宾语，不加 down。

sentences.zh: 药品和其他产品在给人使用之前，通常都要先在动物身上测试。
sentences.en: Medicines and other products are routinely tested on animals before they are cleared for human use.
sentences.why: test sth on animals，介词用 on；be cleared for use 是获批使用。

sentences.zh: 实验室里的老鼠可能被注入某种疾病，以便测量一种新药的效果。
sentences.en: Laboratory mice may be given an illness so that the effectiveness of a new drug can be measured.
sentences.why: effectiveness 是名词，effective 是形容词；so that 后面接完整从句。

sentences.zh: 反对者认为，人类无权让动物承受这种创伤。
sentences.en: Opponents argue that humans have no right to subject animals to this kind of trauma.
sentences.why: subject sb to sth 的 to 是介词；no right to do 用不定式。

sentences.zh: 他们认为，对人类的好处不能成为造成这种痛苦的理由。
sentences.en: They believe that the benefits to humans do not justify the suffering caused.
sentences.why: justify 是及物动词，意思是使某事成为正当的；the suffering caused 是后置分词。

sentences.zh: 动物实验的可靠替代方法，不一定总是现成的。
sentences.en: Reliable alternatives to animal experimentation may not always be available.
sentences.why: alternatives to sth 介词用 to，不用 of；available 作表语。

sentences.zh: 支持者认为，只要能救人的命，一定程度的痛苦是可以被证明正当的。
sentences.hint: 一定程度的 / a certain amount of
sentences.en: Supporters believe that a certain amount of suffering can be justified if human lives are saved.
sentences.why: a certain amount of 修饰不可数名词；be justified 是被动形式。

sentences.zh: 在同样有效的替代方法出现之前，禁止为重要医学研究做动物实验是错误的。
sentences.en: It would be wrong to ban testing on animals for vital medical research until equally effective alternatives have been developed.
sentences.why: until 从句用现在完成时表示到那时为止；equally effective 是副词修饰形容词。

sentences.zh: 所有生物的生命都应该受到尊重。
sentences.en: The lives of all creatures should be respected.
sentences.why: 被动语态 should be respected；creature 可数，泛指用复数。

sentences.zh: 对危险驾驶者的处罚可以起到威慑作用。
sentences.en: Penalties for dangerous drivers can act as a deterrent.
sentences.why: act as 是起作用；a deterrent 可数，要加 a。

sentences.zh: 这些惩罚的目的是让危险驾驶者明白，他们的行为会带来负面后果。
sentences.en: The aim of these punishments is to show dangerous drivers that their actions have negative consequences.
sentences.why: the aim of sth is to do；show sb that 后面接从句。

sentences.zh: 结果是，司机变得更有纪律、更警觉。
sentences.en: As a result, drivers become more disciplined and alert.
sentences.why: disciplined 是形容词，不是过去式；alert 作形容词本身就是警觉的，不加 ly。

sentences.zh: 在人开始开车之前把人教好，这一点极其重要。
sentences.en: It is vitally important to educate people properly before they start to drive.
sentences.why: vitally 修饰 important，比 very important 书面；properly 修饰 educate。

sentences.zh: 政府可以通过投资更好的公共交通来减少交通事故。
sentences.en: Governments could reduce road accidents by investing in better public transport.
sentences.why: by + 动名词表示手段；invest in 的介词是 in。

sentences.zh: 有些人认为，对驾驶违规的严厉处罚是减少交通事故的关键。
sentences.en: Some people think that strict punishments for driving offences are the key to reducing traffic accidents.
sentences.why: the key to doing sth，to 是介词，后面接动名词。

sentences.zh: 在我看来，处罚和一系列其他措施可以一起用，来促成更好的驾驶习惯。
sentences.en: In my view, both punishments and a range of other measures can be used together to promote better driving habits.
sentences.why: a range of 后面接复数名词；be used to do 表示目的。

sentences.zh: 让犯人亲自向年轻人讲自己的经历，可能比单纯惩罚更有说服力。
sentences.en: Prisoners who talk to young people about their experiences may have a stronger effect than punishment alone.
sentences.why: have an effect on sb；alone 放在名词后表示仅仅。

sentences.zh: 城市常被看作充满机会的地方，但住在大都市也有一些明显的缺点。
sentences.en: Cities are often seen as places of opportunity, but there are also some major drawbacks of living in a large metropolis.
sentences.why: be seen as 后面接名词；drawbacks of doing 用动名词。

sentences.zh: 对任何想搬到大城市的人来说，最主要的问题是生活成本很可能高得多。
sentences.hint: 生活成本 / the cost of living
sentences.en: The main problem for anyone who hopes to migrate to a large city is that the cost of living is likely to be much higher.
sentences.why: the cost of living 是固定搭配；be likely to do 用不定式。

sentences.zh: 城市居民得为住房、交通甚至食物付更高的价钱。
sentences.en: Inhabitants of cities have to pay higher prices for housing, transport and even food.
sentences.why: pay for sth；prices 复数配 higher。

sentences.zh: 城市地区往往更容易出现犯罪率高、贫困率高等社会问题。
sentences.en: Urban areas tend to suffer from social problems such as high crime and poverty rates.
sentences.why: suffer from 后面接问题；rates 复数。

sentences.zh: 他们可以投资建设价格可负担的住房，来降低生活成本。
sentences.en: They could invest money in the building of affordable housing to reduce the cost of living.
sentences.why: invest money in sth/doing；affordable housing 不可数，不加 s。

sentences.zh: 选择独居的人，可能比和家人同住的人更独立、更能靠自己。
sentences.en: People who choose to live alone may become more independent and self-reliant than those who live with family members.
sentences.why: than those who 是比较结构的省略写法；self-reliant 中间要有连字符。

sentences.zh: 独居的人可能会感到孤独、孤立和担忧。
sentences.en: People who live alone may experience feelings of loneliness, isolation and worry.
sentences.why: feelings of + 抽象名词；loneliness 不可数。

sentences.zh: 住房需求上升，很可能推高房价和租金。
sentences.en: A rise in demand for housing is likely to push up property prices and rents.
sentences.why: push up 是动词短语，宾语可放中间；demand for 用 for。
